Scroll to explore On the shores of Lake Geneva, Clinique La Prairie Montreux, a renowned longevity clinic in Switzerland, welcomes you into a lush green haven where scientific research and luxury hospitality come together in a cutting-edge facility that includes the historic building where the first longevity treatments were developed. With over 50 doctors on-site, we guide you through our longevity programs and support your retreat with a seamless blend of medical care, well-being, and the culinary excellence of our gourmet restaurant, reserved exclusively for our guests. Five Longevity Programs Revitalisation Master Detox Life Reset Brain potential Healthy weight THE HISTORIC RESIDENCE It is in this beautiful traditional house by the lake that Dr. Niehans began the great adventure of his research on longevity. Behind the windows adorned with the original yellow awnings lies the origin of the secret of life, the general management of Clinique La Prairie, as well as a few prestigious guest rooms. A LUSH GREEN HAVEN The historic residence and its complementary establishment are nestled in the heart of a large garden, facing the lake, where the vegetation changes with the seasons to welcome guests into a haven of serenity. LUXURY HOSPITALITY In an exceptional setting that combines cutting-edge medical facilities with the hospitality of a grand luxury hotel, guests enjoy their retreat week at our luxury clinic in Switzerland, benefiting from every attention necessary for their optimal comfort. Suites Our Suites represent the pinnacle of refined elegance and tailored comfort. Thoughtfully designed to harmonize spaciousness with intimacy, each suite is a discreet haven where wellness meets wonder. With panoramic views and bespoke interiors, these spaces embody our promise: to elevate every moment into an experience of rare beauty and profound restoration. Junior Suite Spectacular views of the lake and gardens may be admired from the balcony or terrace of the Junior Suites. Bathed in sunlight and offering very comfortable space, the Junior Suites are a haven to rest in. Each Junior Suite opens onto a private balcony or terrace with spectacular views of the lake and gardens. Bathed in sunlight and spacious, these suites are designed as personal sanctuaries. Deluxe Room Situated within the wings of the Château, the Deluxe Rooms unfold into expansive interiors with elegant lounge areas. Surrounded by multiple windows, guests are immersed in views of the garden, lake, and Alps for a perfect view all day long. Superior Room Bathed in natural light, our Superior Rooms combine contemporary design with a palette of delicate blues and greens, echoing the tranquility of the lake and surrounding nature. These rooms offer generous space and inspiring views of the Alps and Lake Geneva. Standard Room Our Standard Rooms offer a serene and intimate ambiance, ideal for rest and renewal. Carefully curated with soft tones and elegant furnishings, each room is designed for those who seek calm and comfort. THE CULINARY EXCELLENCE We combine nutrition science with gastronomic artistry, offering meticulously crafted meals that promote health and longevity. Each dish is designed to delight the palate while nourishing the body, reflecting a perfect harmony of flavor, innovation and wellness. seeds A groundbreaking dining experience, blending innovative, plant-based cuisine with a focus on health, sustainability and refined gastronomic artistry. INTRODUCING BENJAMIN LE MAGUET Trained in both cooking and herbalism, Benjamin Le Maguet joins Clinique La Prairie as Executive Chef. After working in Switzerland and Canada, he developed his cuisine at Là-Haut in Chardonne, before founding and leading Maison Le Maguet in Les Evouettes. Wild plants, herbs, vegetables and fermentation are central to a culinary world rooted in plants, seasons and local terroir. His work has been recognised by Gault&Millau and with a Michelin Green Star, awarded to establishments committed to more sustainable gastronomy. Shaped by his experience of the Bocuse d'Or, he brings precision and rigour to a single conviction: food that is good for the body should never stop being a pleasure. LONGEVITY SPA Our award-winning longevity spa is a sanctuary of rejuvenation, offering bespoke treatments that combine cutting-edge wellness techniques with a serene, luxurious environment to restore balance and vitality. Fitness Our fitness center provides state-of-the-art facilities and personalized training programs, designed to optimize physical performance, enhance well-being and support a holistic approach to health. Learn more Why is Switzerland the ideal destination for a longevity clinic? Switzerland combines medical excellence, rigorous standards, and an exceptional natural environment. With clean air, unspoiled landscapes, and a deep-rooted culture of prevention, it is one of the world’s most trusted destinations for longevity and preventive medicine. What makes Clinique La Prairie's Swiss location unique? Set on the shores of Leman Lake since 1931, Clinique La Prairie brings together pioneering longevity science and a holistic approach to wellbeing. In one of Switzerland’s most iconic settings, guests experience a deeply personalized retreat where advanced medicine meets natural serenity. How does Clinique La Prairie differ from other longevity clinics? Clinique La Prairie stands apart from other longevity clinics through its pioneering legacy in longevity since 1931 and its scientifically backed Longevity Method. Unlike traditional wellness clinics, it combines advanced diagnostics, preventive medicine, personalized nutrition, and wellbeing into fully personalized programs designed to optimize health, vitality, and long-term longevity.
